spans.s:
तोरण तोरण, अस्, अम्, m. n. (perhaps fr.
rt. 1. तुर्, to press forwards, i. e. through a passage),
an arch, a gate, an arched doorway, a portal, the
ornamented arch of a door or gateway; any tempo-
rary and ornamental arch; decoration of the gate-post
(with boughs of trees, garlands, &c.); an outer door;
a mound or elevated place near a bathing-place; a
triangle supporting a large balance; (अम्), n. the
neck, the throat; (अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva.
—तोरण-माल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a
place of pilgrimage.
—तोरण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
arched, having ornamental arches.

तोरमाण तोरमाण, अस्, m., N. of a prince;
[cf. तोमराण.]

तोरश्रवस् तोर-श्रवस्, आस्, m., N. of a
Ṛṣi with the patronymic Āṅgirasa; [cf. तौर-
श्रवस.]
